name: STAUD
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $270 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's dresses, knitwear, denim, handbags and shoes, dresses around $600 and beaded Tommy bags at $350, sold through its own stores and site and department stores.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles, United States in 2015 by Sarah Staudinger; George Augusto.

quote.q: It was important for us to not feel 'tech-y,' and for you to really see the garment — not having that kind of Photoshop, butchered look

opview: “It was important for us to not feel 'tech-y,' and for you to really see the garment — not having that kind of Photoshop, butchered look” — Sarah Staudinger, co-founder, Fashionista

facts_read.source: brand site (terms page); Fashionista 2015-11-20; The Zoe Report 2020-02-13; nordstrom.com; Vinted brand page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: STAUD ready-to-wear and shoes (Spring/Summer/Fall 2026, Resort 2027 in stock); EXCLUDED: Resort 2027 pre-order, STAUD Pet/custom pet, home, swim, handbags, collaborations

doors.note: site staud.clothing (/pages/stores is a 404; the header link 'Find a store' goes to /pages/visit-our-stores); 12 US stores, all own doors; no outlets, concessions or coming-soon; Nantucket is seasonal (hours May to October 15) and open on the capture date; the page has no per-store pages, so source_url is the locator page for every row; brand writes STAUD (key matches)

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 from 503 in-stock women's clothing styles (SKU stem before the colour code, e.g. R26F2247BD; colourways collapse) across the TOPS, SWEAT

craft_evidence.madein: 0% — 80 of 80 sampled product pages state fibre and care only, no country
craft_evidence.heritage: not stated: the about-us page renders empty (navigation and footer only); stores page lists Los Angeles locations
craft_evidence.reasoning: Nothing on the site is checkable about making: the about page is empty, product pages give no country, and no maker, mill or facility is named. A 1.
